Product Details: The tip is usually shorter than the distance between the wall tiles Product Description What allows you to do? This tip is used to remove grout between tiles in, p. ex., bathrooms and toilets. Ideal for replacing walls and floor grout or removing grout for replacing broken tiles. The 569 grout attachment tip is usually less than the distance between the wall tiles (head diameter: 3.2mm). The 570 is designed to penetrate the grout of floors and is smaller (head diameter: 1.6mm). These tips are designed for small repairs. If you have a large scale removal need, you may need several tips to remove all grouting. How to use? Use with Dremel Grout Removal Coupling (Model 568). The angled coupling is designed so that the tip is gently pulled through the grout - never pushed. The push action will ruin the tip. There are two guide points on the coupling that help keep the tip between the tiles. Please be careful to prevent tip from touching the tile. This fixture is a solid carbon tip and it will damage the tile if it contacts it if the tool is on. Slow feed speed through grout and with increased attention in older homes is recommended due to metal spacers that may still exist in the grout to be removed. To remove a greater grout depth, start by removing the surface grout. Then adjust the tab to a greater depth and perform a second pass. For corners, you need to remove the leash. Keep your hand firmly and pull the tool carefully for you.
